_doc: Agreed commercial terms per supplier. Every term carries a `status`: `verified` (confirmed against a signed DAMAC PO/LOA and dated) or `unverified` (placeholder -- MUST be confirmed before a final PO is issued). scripts/validate_po.py blocks a FINAL PO that relies on any `unverified` term; use --draft to produce a watermarked draft instead. Populate with scripts/learn_terms.py pointed at previous signed POs.

_fields.payment_terms: Credit period / milestones, counted from what event
_fields.advance_payment: Advance or down payment %, and whether a bank guarantee is required against it
_fields.retention: Retention % withheld per invoice and release conditions
_fields.delivery_terms: Incoterm / delivery basis and who bears offloading
_fields.lead_time: Agreed lead time from PO or from approved sample
_fields.warranty: Warranty / defects liability period and basis
_fields.ld_clause: Liquidated damages for late delivery -- rate and cap
_fields.price_validity: How long rates in the PO are held
_fields.breakage_wastage: Agreed breakage / wastage allowance on supply
_fields.samples_approval: Sample and shade-card approval requirement before production
_fields.title_risk: When title and risk pass to DAMAC
_fields.special_conditions: Anything agreed uniquely with this supplier

payment_terms.value:
Two forms seen on signed POs -- confirm which applies before using either as default:
(A) Direct payment (PO-1617-2026, 11 Jul 2026): Advance Payment invoice submitted on signing; balance paid 30 calendar days from the date of receipt of the invoice, accompanied by signed delivery notes.
(B) Letter of Credit (PO-1616-2026, 18 Jul 2026 and PO-3700-2026, 14 Sep 2026 -- the two more recent POs): First Party provides an LC for 100% of the PO Price inclusive of VAT. Advance Payment = 20% of LC value, paid on submission of an adequate/substantial invoice. Progress Payment = 80% of LC value per delivery, paid within 30 calendar days of the First Party receiving a commercial invoice and delivery notes confirming delivery to site.
